name: AsyncSwap
mechanic: An onchain async order book: exact-input swaps become resting limit orders.
plain: Intercepts exact-input swaps and turns the maker's input into an ERC-6909 claim, opening a resting order at a limit price. A later taker fills it, so trades settle asynchronously rather than instantly.
rules: Exact-input swaps are parked as resting orders, not filled instantly.
The maker's input is held as an ERC-6909 claim until a taker fills it.
